scope: Files specified by the instrument guide and named analytical products. A shared ledger can be updated in more than one stage. Reading URLs resolve relative to the stage page.

groups.description: adjudications.jsonl records rulings and reasons and keeps the original lines. verdicts-D.jsonl keeps the reader verdicts beside the later rulings. findings.jsonl records claims that the return changed or bounded.

groups.purpose: The revised model and coding trail
groups.description: model/ holds the model; model/history.jsonl records revisions. tier_history.jsonl records category changes. Where categories change, scheme_v2.jsonl and assignments_final.jsonl are rewritten so the levels of evidence stay consistent.

groups.purpose: Who was re-checked, and against what
groups.description: recheck-scope.json sorts communities into affected and unaffected, with reasons. handoff-D/recheck/ contains the revised tasks and model. adaptations-recheck.jsonl and verdicts-recheck-D.jsonl keep the new answers beside the earlier ones.
uncomposed-D.md explains the cases the model could not account for. exception-report-D.md sorts adaptations into shared changes, local particulars and unresolved claims.

notes-D3.md explains what the re-check established and what remains uncertain. handback-D3.md summarizes the handoff. out/_closes/model-D3.sha256 names the exact model version carried into the taxonomy.
The revised account returned to the community coders.
